natural_body: Price-sensitive SMBs: 40% off drove signup +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Activation is down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ. Memory_91 demonstrated that activation messaging inside the product improved week-one engagement and nudged accounts to first meaningful action. Memory_86 showed onboarding simplification lifted early adoption. Memory_31 confirmed that signup field reduction improved SMB activation durably. Rather than competing on price (which memory_73 shows harms retention by 12% despite revenue gains) or pursuing enterprise sales (which doesn't address the core SMB activation problem or competitive pressure), activation_messaging directly targets the measurable engagement decline. Verification of memory_31 and memory_91 will confirm the magnitude and durability of prior activation/onboarding lifts before committing. This approach preserves the option to address pricing or enterprise strategies later if needed, and targets sustainable engagement rather than margin-eroding discounts.
